name: historical-globe-engine
description: A programmable Remotion historical globe and template-directed video engine. It combines GeoJSON/d3-geo historical rendering with a manifest-driven automatic scene planner, Remotion template registry, TTS narration, subtitles, and MultiSceneVideo timeline composition.

demoCompositions.purpose: 1931-1945 Sino-Japanese War timeline demo with camera focus, frontlines, attack arrows, event labels, and province hatch overlays.

historyDataFlow.principle: Historical facts are maintained in history-db datasets. AI-generated scenes should consume the database and should not invent territorial control or battle lines.
historyDataFlow.geometryPrinciple: Do not map partial historical regions to whole modern administrative units. Use render=false until a matching historical/city/county/custom-polygon geometry exists.
historyDataFlow.colorPrinciple: Historical region colors are resolved only by history-db/getRegionColor.ts from actors + ownership + renderPolicy. Timeline and Composition layers consume resolved colors and must not recalculate historical actor colors.
historyDataFlow.reproducibilityPrinciple: Territory control snapshots should own region colors/names/controllers. Event process data should own initiator, origin, target, route, process, result, sources, and confidence.
historyDataFlow.factPath: regions + ownership + events. There is no legacy moments fallback.

currentPatch.reason: The 1938 base map statically includes a large Korea/Manchuria-related multipolygon part under Empire of Japan. The Sino-Japanese War demo keeps the land geometry but recolors this part through timeline-controlled ownership before and after Japanese defeat.

world1938.purpose: World countries, colonies, protectorates, and special historical regions for 1938.

chinaProvinces.purpose: China province overlay for province-bounded hatch or province-level styling. It is not precise enough for city/county-level occupation or historical regions that only overlap part of a modern province.

mainConfigFields.geoJsonSrc: World GeoJSON source path under public/.
mainConfigFields.overlayGeoJsonSrc: Optional overlay GeoJSON source path under public/.
mainConfigFields.loopFrames: Number of frames used for one seamless rotation loop.
mainConfigFields.rotationDegreesPerFrame: Degrees of globe rotation per frame.
mainConfigFields.tiltLatitude: Vertical tilt of the orthographic projection.
mainConfigFields.governingAliases: Maps special regions to their governing color subject.
mainConfigFields.hatchRegionNames: World feature NAME values that receive clipped hatch fill.
mainConfigFields.overlayHatchRegionNames: Overlay feature name values that receive clipped hatch fill.
mainConfigFields.labelNames: Country or region labels to render.

commands.textToScenesVideo: npm run text-to-scenes-video -- --text-file input.txt --title "自动镜头视频" --output out/auto-scenes-video.mp4

knownLimitations: The automatic scene DSL exists for template-directed videos, but historical fact extraction is still rule/manifest-driven rather than a fully sourced research agent.
Audio-driven scene timing depends on SRT/captions quality. Without captions, the pipeline still estimates scene durations from text and stretches to total audio length.
Footage retrieval is currently local tag/description scoring. Embedding rerank is designed as an extension point but is not enabled by default.
Only lightweight camera interpolation exists; no full camera keyframe system yet.
Engine layers are not fully split into CountriesLayer, ProvincesLayer, DisputedLayer, LabelsLayer, and LightingLayer.
Scenario configuration is still TypeScript-based rather than external JSON.
China overlay is currently province-level only; city/county-level and historical administrative GeoJSON are not yet integrated.
World 1938 GeoJSON and modern China province overlay are different geometry sources, so local boundaries can mismatch around leaseholds or historical control zones.
The current override of Empire of Japan part 57 is a reproducible base-map patch, not a final historical boundary model.
The Sino-Japanese War dataset is structured and source-tagged, but some control states and frontlines remain illustrative until calibrated against historical GIS or battle map sources.
recommendedNextSteps: Split engine rendering into projection and layer modules.
Add a CameraState and camera interpolation system.
Add a geometry registry for country, province, prefecture, county, historical-admin, and custom-polygon datasets.
Integrate city/county-level or historical administrative GeoJSON before rendering partial historical regions such as Manchukuo's western edge.
Move historical scenario config to JSON with TypeScript validation.
Add optional LLM-assisted visual-beat selection on top of the current template manifest scorer.
Add a geometry-aware template decision layer so map scenes can distinguish routes, regions, leaseholds, ports, and front lines.
